title: EDWARDS PLATEAU BOTANY & Montezuma Cypress in Central Texas
source_creator: Joey Santore / Crime Pays But Botany Doesn't
primary_use: Central Texas / eastern Edwards Plateau visual ID, family morphology, reproductive morphology, limestone/riparian ecology, and Taxodium comparison teaching

rights.public_reuse: not assumed cleared; obtain separate permission/license before publication

curation_rules: Keep only frames that visibly teach a plant, structure, diagnostic character, or field-identification concept.
Treat on-screen taxon labels as strong source-explicit evidence when the auto-caption transcript is garbled.
Preserve Joey's uncertainty when he proposes hybridization, breeding-system explanations, or taxonomic interpretations.
Treat source names as source labels; canonical taxonomy/range reconciliation occurs later in the Hays Botany pipeline.
notes: High-value local source filmed on the eastern edge of the Edwards Plateau just outside Austin, repeatedly tying morphology to thin limestone soils, karst, and riparian habitat.

Joey argues that the central-Texas Taxodium shown here is Taxodium mucronatum rather than T. distichum, citing absence of true knees, habitat continuity southward, smaller cones, and a stouter spreading habit. Preserve this as an attributed source interpretation until project taxonomy/range authorities reconcile it.
Joey suggests possible Berberis swaseyi / B. trifoliolata hybridization but explicitly hedges the claim; do not promote it as established fact.

The Stillingia texana sequence is excellent for reproductive morphology, nectar cups, latex, and male/female comparison, but Joey is actively reasoning through the breeding system and remains uncertain.

Schoenocaulon texanum is described as a geophyte with an underground storage organ, but source wording alternates among corm/tuberous root/bulb and no keeper-grade underground-organ frame is available.
Epipactis gigantea provides a strong orchid-column/pollinia lesson; hoverfly-pollination ecology remains source-derived until promotion verification.
